articles.summary: ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 3, 2026-- Repay Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: RPAY) (“REPAY” or the “Company”), a leading provider of bill payment solutions, announced the appointment of Charles “Chuck” Nabhan as Head of Investor Relations, effective September 1, 2026. In this role, Nabhan will lead REPAY’s Investor Relations strategy, deepening engagement with the investment community and sharpening communication around the company’s growth […]
articles.title: REPAY Appoints Charles Nabhan as New Head of Investor Relations
